task.name: Opt-in mechanism for Claude (+ shared state-repo layout/keying)

comment.message: Research done: Claude plugins expose userConfig (type directory/string/bool, prompted at enable time). Value reaches code via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> env + ${user_config.KEY} substitution; persisted in settings.json pluginConfigs[id].options (per-user). Plan: declare state_repo_dir userConfig, pass to ServicesModule stateRoot. See plan-84.md Research log.

DECISION: two-layer config. Layer1 plugin userConfig (global default, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_*). Layer2 per-repo override in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, full override of path + on/off, enabled flag distinguishes off from unset). Resolution: local override > plugin default > in-repo. Mirrors Claude Local>User precedence; our hook reads the local file. Model reused host-agnostically by tasks 8/9. See plan-84.md Task 7 DECISION.

Task 7 decision REOPENED. Findings: (A) CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_* not guaranteed in Bash-tool env (only hook/MCP/LSP); (B) userConfig not reliably prompted (issue #39455); (C) 0/38 official Anthropic plugins use userConfig — hookify reads its own .local files instead. Candidate direction: shipsmooth reads its own config file(s), no userConfig. Sub-choices open (2-layer vs per-repo-only; own file vs .claude/settings.local.json). Undecided — see plan-84.md Task 7 follow-up research.

DECISION RESOLVED (supersedes the REOPENED state): files-only mechanism. shipsmooth reads its OWN config files at CLI-invocation time (Jackson); NO userConfig / CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_* / settings.json scraping (finding A: env not guaranteed in Bash-tool CLI; C: matches hookify idiom). Two layers: L1 per-repo gitignored .agents/config.json (override, flips on/off + path) > L2 global ~/.config/shipsmooth/config.json default > unset=in-repo. Resolved value feeds ServicesModule stateRoot (Task 5 seam). Host-portable: Tasks 8/9 reuse identical files+resolution. Enable via file edit or future 'shipsmooth config set' (CLI surface finalized in Task 6).

Design complete: single-user TOML config at ~/.config/shipsmooth/ss-config.toml, (remoteUrl,localPath) composite key, no enabled flag, hard error on missing stateDir, auto-create state repo on first use. Human sign-off received.
